description: Send an email via outbound SMTP. Supports both API key and alias auth.

alias_password.description: Generated alias password for authentication. Required for alias-authenticated endpoints. Falls back to FORWARD_EMAIL_ALIAS_PASSWORD env var. Generate one with the generateAliasPassword tool.

alias_username.description: Alias email address for authentication (e.g. user@example.com). Required for alias-authenticated endpoints. Falls back to FORWARD_EMAIL_ALIAS_USER env var.

attachments.description: JSON array of attachment objects with filename, content, and encoding

bcc.description: Comma separated list of BCC recipient email addresses

cc.description: Comma separated list of CC recipient email addresses

date.description: Date value for the email Date header (ISO 8601)

html.description: HTML version of the email body

inReplyTo.description: Message-ID that this email is replying to

messageId.description: Custom Message-ID value for the email header

raw.description: Custom RFC822 formatted message to send as raw email

references.description: Space separated list of Message-IDs in the reference chain

replyTo.description: Email address for the Reply-To header

sender.description: Email address for the Sender header

text.description: Plaintext version of the email body

to.description: Comma separated list of recipient email addresses

name: sendEmail
